scan.note: Open the mod screen (Codex) in the game and scroll: mod names on screen are read and marked as owned (every few seconds, only when the screen changes). Dimmed (unacquired) cards are not marked. Low-confidence matches and owned mods that look unacquired go to "Check"; choose for them. Mods you confirm are skipped in later reads. The "Acquisition" heading below the cards is ignored. Screenshots are checked for dimmed cards only when they are PNG (other formats always go to Check). Reading uses Windows text recognition. Exclusive fullscreen may not be captured; use borderless (windowed) mode or read from screenshots instead.
scan.waiting: Reading (waiting for the screen to change)
scan.found: Reading ({n} mod names found on the last screen)
scan.nobrowser: This browser cannot capture the screen. Open it in Chrome or Edge.
scan.conflict: Check: owned but looks unacquired (choose one)
